title: spergularia maritima subsp. angustata
intro: Spergularia maritima subsp. angustata, commonly known as Sea Sand-spurrey, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in treating various health issues such as wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Spergularia maritima subsp. angustata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
